# trajectory_window

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Bounds a software-manufacturing trajectory by exact endpoints so learning cannot silently mix histories.

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |

| `first_subject_sha` | `string` | yes | Exact first subject in the window. |
| `last_subject_sha` | `string` | yes | Exact final subject in the window. |
| `episode_count` | `integer` | yes | Number of admitted episodes in the window. |
